events.outcome: Current Digicel terms establish deactivation after four months with no usage and new-number assignment after reactivation; current visitor acquisition, international top-up and China roaming exist, but the exact clock-resetting keep-alive action is unresolved.

data.acquisitionSummary: Digicel Jamaica currently sells ordinary prepaid and JMD750 SIM-To-Go packs; SIM-To-Go is explicitly positioned for visitors as well as local users and can be purchased at local retailers. A separate tourist eSIM is also current.

keep.action: Digicel reserves the right to deactivate a prepaid account after four months with no usage. If reactivated after deactivation, the customer is assigned a new number. The reviewed terms do not define which minimum transaction resets the four-month no-usage clock, so no annual keep-alive cost is inferred.

data.chinaActivation: Physical SIM-To-Go requires Jamaica-local purchase/activation; tourist eSIM is sold for visitors, but China-first long-term activation was not established.
data.kyc: Current Digicel prepaid purchase materials require government-issued ID for SIM purchase/porting; passport is explicitly accepted in current switch guidance. SIM-To-Go is marketed to visitors, but its exact activation identity flow is not fully documented on the reviewed page.
data.payment: Digicel International explicitly supports Jamaica top-up/plan purchase online from anywhere in the world with multiple payment methods and recurring top-up options.
data.roamingSms: Current Jamaica Global roaming plans list China. Carrier roaming availability is established, but incoming SMS pricing and third-party OTP reliability in China were not established in this bounded review.
data.holdReason: The four-month no-usage deactivation clock is current, but the exact minimum qualifying activity that resets that clock is not defined; China-specific incoming SMS/OTP behavior also remains unverified.
data.tariffSummary: JMD750 SIM-To-Go; current prepaid plans start at JMD300/day. Account may be deactivated after four months with no usage, and reactivation then receives a new number.
guideSteps: Acquire and activate a current Digicel Jamaica prepaid SIM/eSIM using the current visitor/local flow.
Do not assume a top-up, incoming SMS or balance alone resets the four-month no-usage clock until Digicel defines qualifying usage.
Treat China roaming coverage as carrier availability only, not an OTP success guarantee.
